# Data Source: identitynow_form_definition

Use this data source to look up an existing IdentityNow custom form definition by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_form_definition" "access_request" {
  name = "Access Request Justification"
}

output "form_definition_id" {
  value = data.identitynow_form_definition.access_request.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the form definition.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) The date and time the form definition was created.
- `description` (String) The form definition description.
- `form_conditions_json` (String) The form conditions as a JSON array.
- `form_elements_json` (String) The form elements as a JSON array.
- `form_input` (Attributes List) Form inputs required when creating a form instance. Each item contains `id`, `type`, `label` and `description`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--form_input))
- `id` (String) The form definition ID.
- `modified` (String) The date and time the form definition was last modified.
- `owner` (Attributes List) The form definition owner. Contains `id`, `type` and `name`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owner))
- `used_by` (Attributes List) Systems currently using the form definition. Each item contains `id`, `type` and `name`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--used_by))

<a id="nestedatt--form_input"></a>
### Nested Schema for `form_input`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Form input description.
- `id` (String) Form input identifier.
- `label` (String) Form input name.
- `type` (String) Form input type.


<a id="nestedatt--owner"></a>
### Nested Schema for `owner`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Owner identity ID.
- `name` (String) Owner name.
- `type` (String) Owner type.


<a id="nestedatt--used_by"></a>
### Nested Schema for `used_by`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) ID of the system using the form definition.
- `name` (String) Name of the system using the form definition.
- `type` (String) Type of the system using the form definition.
